contradictions.what: Rep says we were the favourite and load test seemed to win it, yet Halima responded only 'good' to the load test and decided in one meeting.
Rep assumed load test had won it, though questions had shifted to 'who' after the competitor meeting.
We pitched Enterprise support, yet customer never said 'support' and rejected it as a queue with a faster timer.
Rep says we were the better platform, but the customer chose the competitor.
